''See also: [[Meia Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Meia is a blond-haired warrior and trained [[assassin]] who functions as a [[Consultant]]. She possesses significant alchemical enhancements that have transformed her into a [[Soulbound]], granting her superhuman physical capabilities. These augmentations allow her to leap great distances, land with feline grace, and exert immense strength. Her body exhibits unnatural traits, including muscles that writhe beneath her skin, claws that extend from her fingernails, and eyes that shift from blue to a glowing [[Kameira orange]]. While she often wears black clothing and masks for her work, she has also utilized disguises resembling [[Izyrian]] natives to blend into crowds. Her combat repertoire includes the use of [[shears]], poisoned [[darts]], smoke grenades, and explosive charges. Despite her formidable combat prowess, she has been captured as a hostage and has suffered serious injuries, including a chest wound that caused disturbing movements under her skin.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Meia is a pale-skinned woman with short blond hair and eyes that can blaze orange or appear vertically slitted like a [[dragon]]'s. She wears black clothing, including a uniform and a The mask{{!}}mask, and possesses blue [[scales]] that appear irregularly over her skin. Her body is alchemically reinforced and features clawed arms.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A stubborn student with a fragile ego, Meia is a dedicated [[Consultant]] who believes the mission is more important than life. She approaches situations with specific plans, adheres to rules and her duty, and maintains faith in the [[Council of Architects]]. While she is an ally to [[Shera]], she has also been suspected of lying and has acted feral at times.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Meia is a deadly fighter who uses orange [[shears]] and alchemical tools like smoke grenades, explosive charges, and poisoned [[darts]]. Through a [[Shadeshifter]] formula, she can restructure her bones and nails into claws, and she possesses the strength to rend [[steel]] with her teeth or fell trees with a slap. Her body is enhanced by alchemical reinforcements, Nightwyrm venom doses for [[poison]] immunity, and a Deepstriders{{!}}Deepstrider's healing ability.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Soulbound Gardener}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|As a [[Gardener]], Meia carries the [[Intent]] of twelve [[Kameira]] within her body.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c21">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 21</ref> She has also undergone the transformation to become a [[Soulbound]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c21" /> In combat, she utilizes orange [[shears]] that are invested with the ability to see through her enemies.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c21" />}}

</ul></div>

{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Meia is a capable individual who can carry [[Shera]]'s share of a battle and bears a resemblance to her mother, Yala the High Mason{{!}}Yala.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c2">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c4">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 4</ref> She successfully convinced [[Shera]] and others that Imperial Steward Calder Marten{{!}}Calder Marten was not directly responsible for the death of [[Lucan]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 6</ref> Serving as a [[Consultant]], Meia used a circus net to cushion [[Shera]]'s landing after catching her.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 8</ref> During this time, Meia's eyes turned orange and vertically slitted, revealing her [[Kameira orange]] eyes and clawed arms.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8" /> After [[Shera]] commanded her to exit, Meia maintained her faith in the [[Council of Architects]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8" /><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c9">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 9</ref> While her face tightened as she struggled to restrain a smile, Meia waited among the crowd below with [[Shera]]'s backup team.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c10">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 14</ref> [[Shera]] intended to rejoin her once the situation allowed.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c16">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 16</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">13</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Meia]] resembles her mother Yala the High Mason{{!}}Yala.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c4" />}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Shera]] commands [[Meia]] to exit.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8" />}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Meia]]'s face tightened with the effort of restraining her smile.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c10" />}}</li>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Guild Head}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As an interrogator, Meia performs her duties by taking notes during questioning sessions.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c20">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 20</ref> Alongside the High [[Councilors]], she insisted that Jyrine Tessella Marten{{!}}Jyrine undergo interrogation, explaining to [[Shera]] that this was her responsibility as a [[Consultant]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 22</ref> During an attack on the Elder involving glaring orange blades, Meia eventually emerged into the [[courtyard]] alongside [[Shera]] and caught her to stop her from crashing into a wall.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 23</ref> After speaking softly to [[General Teach]] and observing the [[Regents]]' ship, she demonstrated her immense strength, which is sufficient to fell trees with a single slap.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 24</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 25</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 26</ref> The Blackwatch Guild Head{{!}}Guild Head concluded her actions by helping [[Shera]] into the coffin.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c27">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 27</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">11</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Meia]] and the High [[Councilors]] insisted that Jyrine Tessella Marten{{!}}Jyrine be interrogated.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Meia]] tells [[Shera]] it is her duty as a [[Consultant]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Meia]] attacks the Elder with glaring orange blades.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23" />}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Meia]] spoke softly to [[General Teach]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24" />}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Meia]] is a Blackwatch Guild Head{{!}}Guild Head.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c27" />}}</li>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|“The full team,” Meia explained, “consists of thirty-three Shepherds, fourteen combat-trained Masons, a dozen sailor Masons to crew the ship, and us.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c10" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|“You have the heart of a Champion,” he said warmly.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c14" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|“Guard dogs,” Meia snapped. “Kameira hybrids.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c16" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|“I’ll be heading back to the Gray Island,” Meia said at last.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c27" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|“Why come to me with this? Why aren’t Lucan and Meia here too?”<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c3" />}}
